Article 18(3) in the current text has six items; the row listed only items 1-4 as if exhaustive, omitting the academic-research exceptions (items 5-6). Quote, translation and statement extended.

row.title: Purpose limitation exceptions: legal basis, life, public health, cooperation with authorities, academic research
row.statement: The purpose-limitation rules of Article 18(1)-(2) do not apply: (1) where based on laws and regulations; (2) where necessary to protect life, body or property and consent is difficult to obtain; (3) where specially necessary for public health or the sound growth of children and consent is difficult to obtain; (4) where necessary to cooperate with a State body or local government performing legal duties and consent would impede them; (5)-(6) where an academic research institution needs the data for academic research purposes, or data are provided to one for that purpose, unless rights and interests would be unjustly infringed.
row.quote:
３ 　 前二項の規定は、次に掲げる場合については、適用しない。 

 一 　 法令（条例を含む。以下この章において同じ。）に基づく場合 

 二 　 人の生命、身体又は財産の保護のために必要がある場合であって、本人の同意を得ることが困難であるとき。 

 三 　 公衆衛生の向上又は児童の健全な育成の推進のために特に必要がある場合であって、本人の同意を得ることが困難であるとき。 

 四 　 国の機関若しくは地方公共団体又はその委託を受けた者が法令の定める事務を遂行することに対して協力する必要がある場合であって、本人の同意を得ることにより当該事務の遂行に支障を及ぼすおそれがあるとき。 

 五 　 当該個人情報取扱事業者が学術研究機関等である場合であって、当該個人情報を学術研究の用に供する目的（以下この章において「学術研究目的」という。）で取り扱う必要があるとき（当該個人情報を取り扱う目的の一部が学術研究目的である場合を含み、個人の権利利益を不当に侵害するおそれがある場合を除く。）。 

 六 　 学術研究機関等に個人データを提供する場合であって、当該学術研究機関等が当該個人データを学術研究目的で取り扱う必要があるとき（当該個人データを取り扱う目的の一部が学術研究目的である場合を含み、個人の権利利益を不当に侵害するおそれがある場合を除く。）。
row.quote_en:
3. The provisions of the preceding two paragraphs do not apply in the following cases:
1. Cases based on laws and regulations (including ordinances; the same applies below in this Chapter)
2. Cases where it is necessary for the protection of the life, body or property of a person and it is difficult to obtain the person's consent
3. Cases where it is specially necessary for improving public health or promoting the sound growth of children and it is difficult to obtain the person's consent
4. Cases where it is necessary to cooperate with a State body, a local government or a person entrusted by them in performing affairs prescribed by laws and regulations, and obtaining the person's consent is likely to impede the performance of those affairs
5. Where the business operator is an academic research institution etc. and needs to handle the personal information for the purpose of academic research ("academic research purpose") (including where part of the purpose is academic research, except where the rights and interests of individuals are likely to be unjustly infringed)
6. Where personal data are provided to an academic research institution etc. and that institution needs to handle them for an academic research purpose (including where part of the purpose is academic research, except where the rights and interests of individuals are likely to be unjustly infringed)
row.location: Article 18(3), items 1-6 (Restriction by purpose of use: exceptions)
